reviews.text: I’ve been using this for a month and I can really see a difference. My face looks much fuller, hydrated, and "bouncy." It helped get rid of that tired look and gave my skin a healthy, plumped-up appearance. It’s very lightweight and didn't cause any irritation. Highly recommend if you want that youthful glow!
reviews.zh: 我用咗一個月，真係見到分別。我個面睇落飽滿咗好多、水潤，而且「彈」嘅。佢幫我除走咗疲倦嘅樣，令皮膚睇落健康、飽滿。質地好輕，冇引起任何刺激。如果你想要嗰種年輕光采，強烈推薦！

reviews.text: I've read so many reviews on the Internet reviewing this product, and all the reviews were positive so I got really excited to try it , they said it will give your skin the perfect hydration I'm so excited to try it and will give you all my update , can't wait to try this cream ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️
reviews.zh: 我喺網上睇咗好多評論，全部都係正面，所以我好興奮想試吓，佢哋話呢款會令皮膚有完美嘅補水效果。我好期待試，會同大家分享所有最新情況，等不及試呢款面霜 ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

reviews.text: I've been using this for about 3 months now and it is my favourite moisturizer I have tried so far. It makes my skin very soft and smooth. I have combination skin (oily + normal, can get dry during very cold days) and this gel cream sinks really well into the skin. When the days are warm, I only use it at night, but on colder days I also use it during the day (on warmer days sunscreen is enough to "moisterize" my skin). I am definitely purchasing this one again after I finished this one!
reviews.zh: 我用咗大約三個月，佢係我試過最鍾意嘅保濕霜。令皮膚好軟滑。我係混合皮膚（油性加中性，好冷嘅日子會乾），呢款凝膠面霜好容易滲入皮膚。天氣暖嗰陣，我只喺晚上用，但係天冷嘅日子，日間都會用（天氣暖嘅時候，防曬已經夠晒保濕）。用完呢罐，我一定會再買！

reviews.text: So now that it has been a long time: I have to say that this is soo good! if you struggle a lil you might need to get a moisturizing essence or serum before applying this depends on how ur skin is doing BUT I have zero wrinkles so this works!! also gives you an amazing glow. Definitely worthy and I‘m gonna buy it again 🥰
reviews.zh: 用咗好耐之後先嚟講：我一定要話呢款好好！如果你皮膚有少少狀況，塗呢款之前可能要先用保濕精華或者精華液，視乎你皮膚狀況點。但係我冇皺紋，所以呢款對我有效！！仲有好正嘅光澤。絕對值得，我會再買 🥰

reviews.text: I saw an influencer try this once and it looked like so much fun. I know it might sound strange to say this for a beauty product but if you stit all around or even try to spill it, it has the weirdest consistency. After some time it smooths itself out. The girl promoting it mentioned it smells like clean laundry and i cannot unsmell that. I don't know if this is a perk for those reaching 30 but the smell relaxes me. Makes my skin feel seriously soft after using. Recommend!
reviews.zh: 我見過一個網紅試呢款，睇落好好玩。我知道講美容產品呢樣嘢聽落可能有啲奇怪，但係就算你攪動佢，甚至想整瀉佢，佢個質地都好奇怪。過咗一陣子，佢會自己變平滑。推廣嗰個女仔話佢有好似乾淨洗衣物嘅味道，我而家都忘唔咗嗰股味。我唔知呢個係咪三十歲以上人士嘅好處，但係嗰股味道令我放鬆。用完皮膚摸落真係好軟，推薦！

reviews.text:
This moisturizer is amazing for someone who has oily skin! I have combo skin, it makes my skin look amazing and dewy but I feel like I need A LOT more moisture to my face (but thats my fault cuz I use a lot if actives) so if u use actives please make sure to moisturize more than just this! The consistency is soo fun too! 🤣

all in all it IS AMAZING
reviews.zh:
呢款保濕霜對油性皮膚嘅人嚟講好好！我係混合皮膚，用完皮膚睇落好好，好有露珠光澤，但係我覺得我個面仲需要好多好多水分（但係咁係我嘅錯，因為我用好多有效成分），所以如果你用有效成分，請確保保濕唔止係用呢款！質地都好好玩！🤣

總括嚟講，真係好正

reviews.text: Not only does this product work great , but it’s really fun to use, and incredibly cute. It’s got a unique texture, and the gel feels cool going on. The smell is pleasant but not overwhelming or perfumey at all. If you’re even thinking about trying it you should go for it. It’s a little tacky when it’s drying and would be a good step before makeup (I don’t regularly wear any so I haven’t tried yet tho). I’ve noticed the wrinkles around my eyes don’t look as deep, and my face retains moisture better overall. Just a really solid product.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品唔單止效果好好，用起嚟都好好玩，而且超級可愛。佢質地好特別，凝膠塗落嗰陣好涼。味道好聞，但唔會好濃或者好似香水咁。如果你有諗過要試，就應該去試。佢乾嗰陣有少少黏，同埋可以做化妝前嘅好步驟（不過我平時好少化妝，所以未試過）。我留意到眼周嘅紋睇落冇咁深，而且我個面整體都保濕得好啲。真係一款好扎實嘅產品。

reviews.text: This cream is so good. Such a nice smell. It leaves such a healthy glow and a plumping effect as well. It contains 50% hyaluronic acid. Very convenient and very effective. Not the normal cream, I didn’t have high expectations but wow I would repurchase it again. The cream is a memory cream so no matter how you touch it, it will return to its original position. It’s so cool to see! Totally recommend
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜好好。聞落好香。用完會有好健康嘅光澤，同時有飽滿效果。佢含有 50% 透明質酸。好方便，效果好好。唔係普通嘅面霜，我冇抱太大期望，但係哇，我會再買。呢款係記憶面霜，所以無論你點樣摸佢，佢都會返返去原本位置。睇落好得意！完全推薦
